It's not a brilliance, it's a bubble that starts to fly off, leaving just a bitter, invisible taste in your mouth.
You are the fire

pool.baseline: The fire in the brazier is dying, just like everything else. I can still hear them... the sound of the horses screaming, the men calling out for commanders who weren't there to save them. I led them straight into the teeth of it. Because of my pride, a thousand families are mourning tonight. I look at my hands and I don't see a leader anymore. I just see the blood of people who trusted me. I don't think the sun is ever coming up on this life again.
